others.route: Temporary Activity visa (subclass 408), Entertainment Activities stream

note: Australia: New Zealand citizens may visit, study, stay and work there on the Special Category visa (subclass 444) granted on arrival, as long as they remain New Zealand citizens (the Trans-Tasman arrangement). Everyone else coming to work on film, television or live productions needs the Temporary Activity visa's Entertainment Activities stream, up to two years. Home Affairs names no days of such work without a visa. Both pages carry their text in their page description, read from the HTML.

sources.title: Department of Home Affairs, Special Category visa (subclass 444)
sources.said: This temporary visa allows you to visit, study, stay and work in Australia as long as you remain a New Zealand citizen.

sources.title: Department of Home Affairs, Temporary Activity visa (subclass 408): Entertainment Activities stream
sources.said: Entertainment Activities stream — Temporary Activity visa (subclass 408): come to Australia to work on film, television or live productions. Stay up to 2 years.
